mapper.select: SELECT benefit.benefit_id, offer.offer_id, benefit.title, benefit.summary, benefit.detail_text FROM card_benefits benefit INNER JOIN benefit_offers offer ON offer.benefit_id=benefit.benefit_id AND offer.position=1 WHERE benefit.record_type='benefit' AND benefit.structuring_status IN ('RAW', 'PARSE_FAILED') AND offer.reward_type='other' ORDER BY benefit.benefit_id
mapper.update: UPDATE benefit_offers SET reward_type=#{rewardType}, value_type=#{valueType}, value_unit=#{rewardUnit}, calculation_mode='flat', calculation_basis='transaction_amount', stacking_mode='standalone', valuation_scope='transaction', valuation_method='direct', updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE offer_id=#{offerId} AND reward_type='other'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO benefit_rules (rule_id, offer_id, position, priority, rule_name, rule_effect, stacking_mode, reward_value, reward_unit, previous_spend_min_krw, transaction_min_krw, transaction_max_krw, rounding_type, rounding_unit, rule_schema_version, rule_support_status, rule_definition_json, created_at, updated_at) SELECT #{ruleId}, #{offerId}, 1, 100, #{ruleName}, 'grant', 'standalone', #{rewardValue}, #{rewardUnit}, #{previousSpendMinKrw}, #{transactionMinKrw}, #{transactionMaxKrw}, 'floor', 1, 1, 'SUPPORTED', CAST(#{ruleDefinitionJson} AS JSON), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM benefit_rules WHERE offer_id=#{offerId} AND position=1)

INSERT INTO benefit_rule_targets (target_id, rule_id, condition_group, match_mode, target_type, merchant_category_id, merchant_id, target_code, target_name, target_source, target_authority, minimum_place_confidence, created_at, updated_at) SELECT UUID(), #{ruleId}, 1, 'include', 'merchant_category', category.merchant_category_id, NULL, category.category_code, category.category_name, 'CARD_BENEFIT_EXPLICIT', 'ISSUER_CATEGORY', .950, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) FROM merchant_categories category WHERE category.category_code=#{targetCode} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM benefit_rule_targets WHERE rule_id=#{ruleId} AND match_mode='include' AND target_type='merchant_category' AND merchant_category_id=category.merchant_category_id)

INSERT INTO benefit_rule_targets (target_id, rule_id, condition_group, match_mode, target_type, merchant_category_id, merchant_id, target_code, target_name, target_source, target_authority, minimum_place_confidence, created_at, updated_at) SELECT UUID(), #{ruleId}, 1, 'include', 'merchant', NULL, merchant.merchant_id, merchant.normalized_name, merchant.name, 'MERCHANT_EXPLICIT', 'MERCHANT_EXACT', .990, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) FROM merchants merchant WHERE merchant.normalized_name=#{targetCode} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM benefit_rule_targets WHERE rule_id=#{ruleId} AND match_mode='include' AND target_type='merchant' AND merchant_id=merchant.merchant_id)

INSERT INTO benefit_rule_targets (target_id, rule_id, condition_group, match_mode, target_type, merchant_category_id, merchant_id, target_code, target_name, target_source, target_authority, minimum_place_confidence, created_at, updated_at) SELECT UUID(), #{ruleId}, 1, 'include', 'all_merchants', NULL, NULL, 'ALL', '전 가맹점', 'ALL_MERCHANTS', 'ALL_MERCHANTS', 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM benefit_rule_targets WHERE rule_id=#{ruleId} AND match_mode='include' AND target_type='all_merchants')

INSERT INTO benefit_limit_policies (limit_policy_id, offer_id, policy_name, limit_period, limit_type, limit_unit, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{monthlyLimitPolicyId}, #{offerId}, '자동 구조화 월 보상 한도', 'monthly', 'reward_amount', CASE #{rewardUnit} WHEN 'percent' THEN 'KRW' ELSE #{rewardUnit} END, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6))

INSERT INTO benefit_limit_tiers (limit_tier_id, limit_policy_id, position, limit_value, previous_spend_min_krw, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (UUID(), #{monthlyLimitPolicyId}, 1, #{monthlyRewardLimit}, #{previousSpendMinKrw}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6))
mapper.update: UPDATE card_benefits SET structuring_status='STRUCTURED', structuring_note=NULL, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE benefit_id=#{benefitId}
UPDATE card_benefits SET structuring_status='PARTIAL', structuring_note=#{note}, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE benefit_id=#{benefitId}
